policy: Reviewed translations, concise summaries and user-value labels supported by pinned display metadata. Retain package install identity; skip on upstream display changes. At most three value labels per plugin; no category or package-name inference.

description.en: Runtime module injection without restarting DSH, with router-standard presets; plugin entry: injector/.
description.zh: 免重启注入 DSH 模组，附带 router-standard 预设；插件入口为 injector/。

description.en: Interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions and tools.
description.zh: 在终端中交互管理 DSH 智能体、会话和工具。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only LLMs, powered by the free Antigravity CLI
description.zh: 通过 Antigravity CLI 为纯文本模型提供图像理解能力。

title.zh: Agent Teams 多智能体协作

description.en: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness: multi-agent team collaboration (captain, members, tasks with dependencies, messaging) driven by natural language, with a tree monitor in the web GUI
description.zh: 用自然语言编排多 Agent 团队，支持任务依赖、成员消息与网页树状监控。

description.en: Access desktop DSH from your phone by scanning a QR code, over LAN or the internet with live mirroring.
description.zh: 手机扫码访问电脑上的 DSH，支持局域网、公网与实时同屏。

description.en: A blue fish companion in DSH with desktop interaction, chat and a balance wallet.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中养一只蓝色鱼宠物，支持桌面互动、聊天和余额钱包。

description.en: Use local Wallpaper Engine scene, web or video wallpapers in DSH with adjustable liquid-glass styling.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中显示本地 Wallpaper Engine 场景、网页或视频壁纸，并调整液态玻璃外观。

description.en: Connect models available in the WorkBuddy desktop app to DSH.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用提供的模型接入 DSH。

description.en: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain + pixel-level tools. Remote vision providers, including the default free fallback, receive image content unless strict local-only use is configured.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉链路与像素工具；远程视觉服务会接收图像，除非配置为严格仅本地使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, OCR, grounding, UI restoration, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图像问答、OCR、界面定位与还原、像素差异和 Artifacts 工具。

description.en: Web search, X search and page fetching for models without native web access.
description.zh: 为缺少原生联网能力的模型提供网页搜索、X 搜索与页面抓取。

description.en: Manage DSH red-team security research presets and runtime plugins from one settings page.
description.zh: 在一个设置页中管理 DSH 红队安全研究预设与运行时插件。

description.en: DSH ad-infestation plugin: localized Chinese portal ads and English scam-ad parody, with fake pop-ups, a jackpot wheel, rewarded inference ads, and fake-game animation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中展示恶搞弹窗、抽奖转盘、激励式推理广告与假游戏动画。

description.en: Render interactive UI in assistant replies, including charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid and 3D scenes.
description.zh: 在助手回复中渲染交互界面，支持图表、表单、测验、Mermaid 和 3D 场景。

description.en: Bring ChatGPT-like image generation to DeepSeek Harness — Gemini, OpenAI, Seedream, DashScope, local ComfyUI & more.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 Gemini、OpenAI、Seedream、DashScope 和本地 ComfyUI 等图像生成服务。

description.en: Research-assistant plugin suite (literature search, research wiki, LaTeX compile, independent subagent review) for the DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 提供文献检索、研究 Wiki、LaTeX 编译与独立子 Agent 审阅工具。

description.en: A visual, non-linear conversation workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可视化、非线性的对话工作区。

description.en: AnySearch web search and fetch providers plus advanced tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 AnySearch 网页搜索、页面抓取和进阶工具。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel summary bundle for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过本地 IMAP 下载发票，支持 OCR、归档与 Excel 汇总。

description.en: Voice AI girlfriend for DeepSeek Harness: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS voice replies, companion animation window, QQ two-way chat. Needs the repo's voice bridge + NapCat.
description.zh: 提供麦克风输入、语音回复、动画陪伴和 QQ 双向聊天；需配置仓库中的语音桥及 NapCat。

description.en: Local-first code intelligence graph for DeepSeek Harness: structural search, blast radius, temporal memory, and 27 agent skills over Memtrace MCP.
description.zh: 通过 Memtrace MCP 提供本地优先的代码结构搜索、影响范围分析、时序记忆与 Agent 技能。

description.en: Create and edit agent preset prompts in Settings, and register user presets from disk.
description.zh: 在设置页创建和编辑 Agent 预设提示词，并注册磁盘上的用户预设。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, Grok (X Premium), GitHub Copilot, and Google Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with OAuth login from the web Settings page
description.zh: 通过网页设置中的 OAuth 登录，接入 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、GitHub Copilot 和 Antigravity 等订阅模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness community plugin: drive the OpenStory multi-agent simulation (Dream of the Red Chamber) as native agent tools
description.zh: 通过 DSH 原生 Agent 工具驱动 OpenStory《红楼梦》多智能体模拟。

description.en: A customizable glass theme for DSH Web UI, with blur, animated or video wallpapers and motion.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供可定制的毛玻璃、动态或视频壁纸、统一玻璃外观和动效。

description.en: Layered long-term memory, experience capture, skills and todos, plus external AI CLI dispatch and a web management UI.
description.zh: 提供分层长期记忆、经验沉淀、技能与待办管理，并调度外部 AI CLI；附网页管理界面。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness on Chrome and Edge
description.zh: 在 Chrome 和 Edge 中为 DSH 显示实时 WebGPU 海洋主题。

description.en: A QQ-pet-style desktop companion in the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示 QQ 宠物形态的桌面宠物。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the iOS Simulator — build, run, and interact with a live simulator stream inside a conversation. Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 在对话中构建、运行并操作 iOS 模拟器实时画面；原作者标注测试版本为 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: DSH inline visualization plugin: a visualize tool + bundled skill let the model render interactive HTML fragments as sandboxed cards in the conversation (Codex /visualize semantics).
description.zh: 通过 visualize 工具与配套技能，在对话中渲染沙箱化的交互 HTML 卡片。

title.zh: Agent Team GUI 团队编排

description.en: Persistent multi-model squads for DeepSeek Harness with durable orchestration, DAG workflows, run history, and provider-reported token usage
description.zh: 提供持久化的多模型团队、DAG 工作流、运行历史与提供方报告的 token 用量。

description.en: An interactive DSH terminal UI with streaming Markdown, tool cards, themes, session tabs and diagnostics.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供交互式终端界面，支持流式 Markdown、工具卡片、主题、会话标签与诊断信息。

description.en: Shared dsh-trading bundle for order/cancel approval and agent preset registration.
description.zh: 为 dsh-trading 提供统一的下单与撤单审批入口，以及共享 Agent 预设注册。

description.en: Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 原生模型适配器接入 OpenCode Zen 模型，无需 API Key。

title.zh: Reverse Skill 逆向研究技能

description.en: A DSH skill router pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing and security research.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

title.zh: 滑动变祖 推理强度皮肤

description.en: An opt-in adaptive reasoning-effort slider skin for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可选择启用的自适应推理强度滑块皮肤。

description.en: Import other AI coding agents’ histories into resumable DSH sessions, preserving tool calls, reasoning and results, with reverse export.
description.zh: 将其他 AI 编程 Agent 的记录导入 DSH 继续对话，保留工具调用、推理与结果，并支持反向导出。

description.en: A separate read-only model reviews approval requests, with fail-closed fallback and full session logging.
description.zh: 用独立的只读模型审阅审批请求；失败时拒绝放行，并保留完整会话日志。

title.zh: DSH 模型与推理选择器

description.en: A Codex-style model and reasoning selector using model-advertised effort levels.
description.zh: 提供 Codex 风格的模型与推理强度选择，使用模型声明的强度等级。

description.en: Bridge the Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems: a general Pi Host ABI that runs unmodified Pi extensions as native DSH plugins, with compatibility inspection and Pi-to-DSH MCP config translation.
description.zh: 把未修改的 Pi 扩展接入为原生 DSH 插件，并检查兼容性、转换 MCP 配置。

description.en: Industry-chain research, public-source policy/news tracking, company scans and auditable reports. Research only; not investment advice.
description.zh: 提供产业链、政策新闻跟踪、公司扫描与可追溯研究报告；仅用于研究，不构成投资建议。

evidence.description: 中华传统智慧（玄枢）AI Agent 技能包的 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Cordis 插件：八字/紫微/六爻/梅花/奇门/风水/五运六气/体质全融合，本地确定性引擎 + 可视化 Dashboard，一行 dsh plugin add 安装。

title.zh: 玄枢 传统文化技能

description.en: A Chinese traditional culture skill pack for DSH with local engines and a visual dashboard.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的中华传统文化技能包，附本地引擎与可视化面板。

evidence.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin to manage network proxy (system / manual / direct) with a live settings UI. [dsh-plugin]

description.en: Manage system, manual and direct network proxy modes for DSH from a live settings UI.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理 DSH 的系统代理、手动代理与直连模式。

description.en: Tw93's open-source computer cleanup tool for macOS and Windows, via the official DSH skill. Analyze disk usage, preview cleanup and read system health; ask before removal. Requires the local Mole CLI.
description.zh: Tw93 的开源电脑清理工具，通过官方 DSH 技能插件分析 macOS / Windows 磁盘占用、预览清理和读取系统状态，征得同意后再清理；需本机 Mole CLI。
